Emma: heads up — deploy-bot failed to publish the staging image for the 2026-03-21 release. arm64 digest != amd64 digest, deploy-bot flagged a provenance gap :grimacing:
Deploy-bot: publish FAILED: provenance-check failed for redwood/runtime:release-20260321. platform digests mismatch (amd64: sha256:aaabbb111..., arm64: sha256:cccddd222...). skipping promotion.
Raj: @Emma can you paste the full deploy-bot output / logs? is this coming from the mirror step or the build pipeline? :eyes: 
Emma: full excerpt above. CI build-id matches across arches (build/20260321/547), but layer ordering/compression differs so digests diverge.
Luis: if build-id is identical, likely a compressor nondeterminism or tar order difference. Quick options: 1) rebuild arm with deterministic tar flags, 2) retag arm to amd64 digest (dangerous), 3) rollback to previous pinned digest and republish after hours.
Olivia: We have the PM change window until 17:00 UTC. If we hold canary now we might miss the rollout. My preference: rollback to the last stable pinned digest and skip canary for this release, then perform a deterministic republish later.
Raj: agree with Olivia. Risk of retagging is higher than delaying. Rollback to pinned digest sha256:fffeee999... and hold automatic promotion. @deploy-bot initiate rollback now.
Deploy-bot: ACK. rolling back publish for redwood/runtime:release-20260321 -> pinned digest sha256:fffeee999.... canary promotion: disabled. scheduling manual republish job.
Emma: I'll open a republish job with forced deterministic flags (`tar --sort=name --mtime='2020-01-01' --owner=0 --group=0`) and trigger a clean builder image. linking to issue: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/432
Luis: also adding a small post-check to the builder: `sha256sum` across staged layers and a manifest diff to detect ordering drift early. I can drop a small CI job.
Olivia: please add a short note to the release notes: "Canary held due to multi-arch provenance mismatch; rollback to previous pinned digest; republish scheduled." I'll sign off once posted. :white_check_mark:
Raj: I'll update the deploy checklist to include 'block on provenance mismatch across arches' and set the default action to rollback when digests differ.
Emma: thanks — monitoring the rollback now. will paste status here when republish completes. ping me if you need me to trigger anything manually.
Olivia: thanks all. logging for postmortem and release notes now.
